name: Serath Qasir
source_profile: ● Serath Qasir (LE) is a wealthy merchant and keeper of water records. Serath has begun selling limited access to Qasari trade routes to Cadorian merchants without the council's authorization. He believes commercial influence will ultimately make him indispensable to both sides.
source_reference: Handbook v0.4, pp. 152–161; Legendarium v1.0, pp. 148–157; project NPC index; Legendarium v1.0, p. 68 (source excerpt; may be partial)
